Container.Name: NovaCortex-Web

Branch.TagDescription: Rolling tag — always the newest published release

Container.Overview:
Web UI for NovaCortex — self-hosted, MCP-native long-term memory for AI agents.
This template installs the Web UI container ONLY. It is a thin front end: it needs a running NovaCortex API to talk to, and the API in turn needs SurrealDB, Qdrant and Redis. Use this template if you already run the NovaCortex API (on this server or another host).
>> For a fresh install, install the whole stack with Docker Compose instead. <<
Full stack (SurrealDB + Qdrant + Redis + API + Web, plus an optional offline Ollama sidecar):
1. Install the "Docker Compose Manager" plugin from Community Apps. 2. Add a new project named "novacortex". Compose Manager creates /boot/config/plugins/compose.manager/projects/novacortex/ 3. Put docker-compose.unraid.yml from the repository in that folder as docker-compose.yml (repo root, or the identical copy in templates/unraid/). 4. Create a .env next to it. scripts/gen-env.sh writes one with strong random secrets; .env.unraid.example documents every value. Set APPDATA=/mnt/user/appdata/novacortex and, for a fully offline install, run scripts/gen-env.sh --local-ai and start the stack with the "local-ai" profile. 5. Compose Up. Then read the one-time bootstrap code with "docker logs novacortex-api 2>&1 | grep -A1 'Bootstrap code'" and paste it on the login page to mint your admin token.
Ports: Web UI 3000, API 3001. Data lives under /mnt/user/appdata/novacortex, so it survives docker.img rebuilds and is covered by Unraid appdata backups.
Container.Description:
NovaCortex gives AI agents a persistent, queryable memory that lives on your own hardware. Typed memories (episodic, semantic, procedural, working) with salience and decay, semantic vector search over Qdrant, a typed relation graph, a document knowledge base, and per-agent namespaces. Agents connect over MCP (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code), the REST API, the CLI or the TypeScript/Python SDKs. Memory can be exported and re-imported as portable JSON, MessagePack or AES-256-GCM-encrypted archives, so there is no lock-in.
Embeddings are optional and off by default. Point the API at an Ollama sidecar to keep every byte of memory text on this server, or at OpenAI (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) if you prefer hosted embeddings. Apache-2.0; the free tier needs no key and no account.
This container serves the Web UI on port 3000 and proxies browser calls to the API over the Docker network via API_INTERNAL_URL, so the API does not need to be published publicly.
Container.Requires: A reachable NovaCortex API (this template does not install one). Install the API with the NovaCortex-API template, or install the whole stack with the Docker Compose Manager plugin as described in the overview. Web UI and API must run the same NovaCortex version.
